svg.title: Sentry issuing workload certificates in self-hosted mode
svg.desc: A filesystem mark on the left holds the certs. A line with a head at each end leaves its top, runs up and along to Sentry, the Dapr certificate authority, which stands above the middle of the picture, and is labelled "Read the existing root and issuer certs, or create a self-signed root". To the right of the filesystem and on the same line, App A and App B each run beside a Dapr sidecar, and the two sidecars are joined by a line with a head at each end carrying a shield and padlock marked mTLS. A line leaves each sidecar on the side facing the other and rises between the two apps, where the pair merge into one arrow into the bottom of the Sentry hexagon, labelled "Request a workload certificate". Below the apps an operator figure stands in the middle. One run goes up from the operator and forks into both sidecars, labelled "Set the trust anchors from those files, as environment variables"; another leaves the operator sideways and reaches the filesystem, marked optional, because the operator may bring existing root and issuer certs.
